name: Guiding Bolt

modifiers.text: only the next attack roll against it, before the end of your next turn

summary: Ranged spell attack for 4d6 Radiant damage; the next attack roll against the target has Advantage.
text: Make a ranged spell attack against a creature within range. On a hit it takes 4d6 Radiant damage, and the next attack roll made against it before the end of your next turn has Advantage. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 1.
